title: Fine-tune job starts: 8 idle GPUs warm from 34C to 67C and power jumps 6x in a minute

expected.reason: Workload transitioned queued -> running at that minute. Temperature settles exponentially at 67C, well under 87C, with clocks at normal boost. A big change, but the expected one.
expected.naiveRuleThatWouldFalselyTrigger: temperature rise > 20C in 10 min, or power change > 300% vs 1h baseline
suppressionEvidence: workload.status changed to running at deviation onset

context.note: Baselines must be conditioned on workload state (idle vs loaded), not one global baseline per GPU.
